plan.title: Measure large-workspace status and validate reliability across available runtimes

criteria.description: A 10000-file 100MiB workspace passes current evidence, becomes stale after mutation and documents restoration semantics; a reusable benchmark measures the same workload.
Duplicate execution preserves the original owner and does not publish false success.
Cancellation recovery remains blocked when child cleanup is uncertain across processes.
Storage completion failure leaves unsatisfied running authority.

limitations: Record measured p95 latency and memory with workload, revision, environment and sample count; 2 seconds is an initial target, not an unmeasured guarantee.
Use installed toolchains and local container images only. Go 1.23 and Windows runtime may remain unverified; cross-vet is not runtime evidence.
Per-resource locking and before/after hashing do not guarantee global snapshots or detection of A-to-B-to-A changes.
No actual pushes, remote CI, releases, installations or settings changes.
